evidence.limits: Sound effects and music not determinable. Exact caption wording after the first 5 s is sampled once a second. Platform names in the first minute come from frames plus machine transcript. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Matan hands out 200 shekel notes per platform (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) that shoppers prove they follow, in the Gold Mall in Rishon LeZion.
audience: his followers and mall shoppers; viewers who might follow him on three platforms for a cash reward
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches the video: a giveaway list (follow, like, comment or tag, share to story) and a closing line about the next mall. The video itself only shows the follow check on the street; the like, tag and story-share steps are in the caption only.

opening.first_frame: Matan in a grey shirt, medium shot inside a mall, leaning on a railing, fanning a stack of 200 shekel notes, a lav mic in his raised hand, word-by-word caption in the middle.
opening.s0_1: Direct to camera, word-by-word captions 'אני חזרתי לחלק כסף'. Cut at about 0.75 s to a close-up of the notes in his hand.
opening.s1_3: Close-up of the cash ('לעוקבים שלי'), back to the medium shot at about 1.75 s, a Gold Mall building picture inset at 2.25 to 2.75 s ('בקניון הזהב').
opening.s3_5: 'בראשון לציון', 'בואו נראה'; at about 4.25 s hard cut to the first street encounter outside Bershka, caption 'כל פלטפורמה'.
opening.visual_hook: Fan of 200 shekel notes held to camera, then a close-up of the cash.
opening.spoken_hook: Machine transcript: 'אז אני חזרתי לחלק כסף לעוקבים שלי, הפעם אני בקניון הזהב בראשון לציון'
opening.text_hook: אני חזרתי לחלק כסף לעוקבים שלי בקניון הזהב בראשון לציון
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 4.2 (every platform you follow pays 200 shekels)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: partly: 'אז אני חזרתי לחלק כסף' assumes earlier giveaway Reels, but cash in hand and the words make the premise clear.
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: yes (stack of 200 shekel notes, the word 'כסף'); the amount 200 is spoken at about 4.2 s
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions carry every word and the cash is visible

visual.subject_placement: Matan centred or on the right with the other person on the left; the opening and the closing are centred to camera; phone close-ups fill the frame.
visual.setting: Gold Mall (Rishon LeZion) incl. Zara and Bershka entrances, shop floor and escalator areas, a second mall hall with a glass roof around 50 s
visual.lighting: bright mall lighting, natural and mixed shop light; handheld smartphone look
visual.color_contrast: neutral shop colours; white captions plus green and cyan highlights; Matan's grey shirt is low contrast against the walls
visual.props_and_gestures: A fan of 200 shekel notes, a lav mic held near his mouth, phones held up to show follow status, a pointing and hand-counting gesture while talking to camera at the end.
visual.supporting_footage: Close-ups of participants' phone screens showing his Instagram and YouTube profiles; an inset photo of the mall building; a banknote graphic.
visual.persistent_branding: none; at the end TikTok, Instagram and YouTube icons with a green line about 200 per platform appear at the bottom
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 4 s direct to camera in the mall; 4 to 24 s first encounters with a man and a woman, phone checks; 24 to 48 s inside Zara with three women; 48 to 59 s second hall, two young men, a rooftop hall; 59 to 68 s Matan talking to camera by an escalator with platform icons.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is a frame from the Zara scene (a woman holding notes and a phone) with the text 'מתן מחלק כסף חלק ב'' while the Reel opens on him alone with the cash.
visual.ui_interference: Captions sit mid-frame (about 50 to 55 percent down), clear of the zones. The platform icons and green line at 1:00 to 1:07 fall in the bottom 35 percent.

editing.edit_function: Cuts jump between encounters and shorten waits; phone close-ups give proof of the follow, 200 shekel graphics and confetti reward each success, and the tight cash shot at the start adds stimulation.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 4s: slow direct pitch with two cuts
t=4 to 14s: fast, cuts about every 1.2 s
t=33 to 38s: one longer take (a shot lasts about 5 s)
t=42 to 50s: a long take in Zara
editing.ending: Matan to camera by an escalator naming the next stops (Haifa, Jerusalem, Beer Sheva, Ramat Gan) with platform icons and a green 'על כל פלטפורמה תקבלו ממני 200' line; last word 'בסרטון'.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the reactions to the cash and the repeated check-and-pay rhythm may invite scanning again; nothing in the evidence says people rewatch.

sound.delivery: Fast, energetic host patter at the start, short dialogue lines with participants (transcript shows lines of one to three seconds) and a few pauses.
sound.sync: Word-by-word captions follow speech; cuts land on speech beats (the cut to the first encounter at 4.2 s lines up with the start of the second transcript line at 4.2 s).

text.colour_coding: White for most words; the other person's words in yellow, cyan, red or green at times; green glow on money words and running amounts ('400', '200'); the final list uses yellow for city names.
text.placement: Centre of the frame (about 50 to 55 percent down); platform icons bottom third at the end.
text.style: Bold white sans with a soft shadow; green glow on amounts; small green line with a banknote symbol in the end card.
text.density_and_read_time: One word at a time, readable at a glance; the closing green line is longer and small.
text.language: Short phrases, spoken Hebrew: 'מקווה שזה יעזור לך עם הקניות', 'כל הכבוד'.
text.caption_structure: First line 'מחלק לכם 2,500₪' with a money emoji; a numbered 4-step list of how to win (follow, like, comment or tag, share to story for 24 hours); a follow-for-money line; sign-off 'נתראה בקניון הבא'; no hashtags; caption was edited.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew words render correctly; the money amount and the currency symbol in the end card look mixed in the green line ('200₪'); no broken RTL seen.

story.setup: Matan announces he is back at the mall giving 200 shekels per platform a person follows.
story.stakes: Whether each stranger really follows him; a no means no money (for example a woman not on YouTube at about 21 to 23 s).
story.progression: Encounter after encounter (man at Bershka, woman, Zara shoppers, girls, a pair of men) with a running pattern: ask, show the phone, get paid.
story.payoff: Several people are paid 200 on each platform they follow.
story.resolution: He announces the next malls and tells viewers to follow.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: cash changes hands in several encounters
friction_points: t=24 to 48s: a long Zara stretch in one place - interpretation: pace drops compared to the first 24 s
t=0 to 4s: the intro is a four-second direct pitch before any encounter - interpretation: a small delay for the main action

explicit_prompts.wording: לשתף את הסרטון בסטורי ל-24 שעות

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 44 comments, not representative. Many requests to visit a city ('מתי באר שבע', 'תעשה גם באשדוד'); a stretch of friend tags; one critic: 'לא ברורה לי המטרה הערכית'; one says he left details twice with no reply. Tag comments are repeated in a block.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Short replies (identical lines twice) reminding commenters to follow on YouTube and TikTok and share to story, with a money emoji.

conversion.cta_timing: about 59 to 67 s in the video; the caption list also asks for like, comment or tag and story share
conversion.offer: Cash giveaway: 200 shekels per followed platform in the video; 2,500 shekels in the caption.
conversion.proof: On-street handovers of cash with phone screens as proof.
conversion.urgency: next malls named, a 24 hour story share in the caption
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Follow Matan on Instagram, YouTube and TikTok; caption lists comment or tag and story-share conditions; no keyword. A creator reply says to share the video in a story.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the whole video is about following for cash
conversion.destination: his profiles on three platforms, matching the promise; no link visible

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film. Many identifiable adults (shoppers, staff, a cameraman in the frame at 14 s) and shop logos (Zara, Bershka, Foot Locker) shown without blurring; their phone screens show his profiles. Not freely copyable for a book brand: shoppers are identifiable.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: the premise (cash for a follow) is visible within a second, and the repeated check-pay beat with on-screen amounts gives constant small payoffs. The captions make it work without sound, and the Reel ends with a clear follow ask.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the central give-and-take stays the same for 60 s with long takes in Zara, and the end ask is dense.

standout_moments.what: Hard cut to the cash close-up while the word 'כסף' is captioned: the product (money) is shown at once.
200 banknote graphic and green 'שקלים' caption pop as money is paid, making the reward visible.
A refusal ('לא רשומה ליוטיוב') adds a bit of risk: the follow is checked, not assumed (about 21 to 23 s).
Platform icons with a green '200 per platform' line turn the ask into a clear call to action.
